content:
anna_sales: New RFI from Synergy Health just came in. They want a 4-week Dedicated POC, an embeddings vs chat capability matrix, explicit KMS/HSM support details, and a provisional POC quote. I uploaded their file: synergy_rfi_oct2024.pdf. Can we assemble a draft today?
jordan_se: I can draft the capability matrix + fallback example. Quick confirm: propose 2x A10 baseline for POC or do we start smaller? They mentioned steady 80 QPS with 300 QPS bursts.
maria_ps: Perf will run synthetic workload if they can't provide scrubbed data. I'll own the perf plan; target p99 unknown  ask them for <150ms if they want low latency.
anna_sales: I'll request sample corpus and SLOs. Finance: can we get a provisional 4-week POC number to include in the RFI?
finance_zoe: Provisional stub: 2x A10 baseline + managed ops ~ $48k for 4 weeks (subject to discount/contract). Mark as "provisional".
sam_security: Security note: Hosted supports tenant KMS separation; Private supports HSM via partner (CloudHSM/YubiHSM) and requires an addendum. For PHI/BAA we need legal sign-off. I'll draft KMS appendix.
jordan_se: Fallback paragraph draft: "Primary Dedicated pool is preferred; sustained high queueing (>80% util for 2min or median queue >5s) triggers: 1) reserved burst nodes, 2) cross-region failover (if allowed), 3) graceful model fallback to smaller variant with notification headers. Circuit-break thresholds configurable in Console." Use and shorten if needed.
maria_ps: I'll upload perf plan + simple capability matrix by 11am PT. Matrix sample: "Embeddings: Hosted/Dedicated/Private = Yes/Yes/Yes; Private KMS: No/Yes/Yes; HSM: No/Optional/Partner; SLA: Standard/Enhanced/Enterprise".
anna_sales: Action items: (1) I'll ask Synergy for sample corpus and SLOs; (2) @maria_ps finalize perf matrix; (3) @jordan_se pricing + fallback paragraph; (4) @sam_security & legal to prepare KMS/HSM appendix; (5) I'll assemble and send draft to Synergy COB tomorrow, mark provisional items.
doc-bot: Uploaded: synergy_rfi_draft_v1.pdf -> https://files.redwood.internal/rfi/1767701234/synergy_rfi_draft_v1.pdf
anna_sales: Thanks team, please flag any blockers here.
